images.caption: Front of the Ebenezer Lane House, located at 318 Wayne Street (U.S. Route 6) in Sandusky, Ohio, United States.  Built in 1853, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.

brief: A resort-town cottage lot: Ebenezer Lane House, a 19th-century lake-town house. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: northern Michigan resort cottages of this kind are 1880-1950 buildings; Commons has almost no newer ones. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Ebenezer Lane House (Sandusky, 1840s), now apartments ('THE FIRELANDS'): a three-storey limestone Italianate cube with deep bracketed eaves, a two-level entry porch reached by curving double stairs with iron rails, a frame sunroom addition

why.note: Sandusky's own limestone: the 'Stone City' of Lake Erie, quarried under the town
